My dear [Miss Sewell](../persons.html#1301)[^2]
I think you will like to see what the [Literary Churchman](../others.html#76) says of our [performance](../books.html#71) but please return it

yours sincerely

C M Yonge
Do you know anyone who would like one of these photos I am selling them towards the school at Eastleigh[^2]

[^1]: Black-edged paper.

The words ‘of our heliotropes’ written on the reverse in CMY’s hand.

[^2]: The name has been erased in ink.

[^3]: The [Church of the Resurrection](../others.html#188), Eastleigh, being consecrated, funds were now being raised for a Church of England school in connection with it.

The photographs were of CMY herself.
